messages:
alana: Pushed a compact prototype of the first-run setup to Figma. Looking for quick takes on: persistent rail vs modal, sample project surface area, and any accessibility or copy blockers.
sofia: My vote is for the rail — less modal interruption. But it must be dismissible and keyboard-accessible.
mike: Rail looks good. Design note: collapse to an icon strip on narrow screens. Need a variant for the dashboard header.
rahul: Implementation: collapse state in localStorage for self-serve; add server-side restore as an opt-in for Private customers.
jess: Support asks that we show ephemeral demo orgs as server-restorable to avoid lost progress tickets.
sofia: Copy: avoid passive labels. Use commands: "Connect a model or try sandbox" rather than "Connect a model".
aria: A11y checklist: ensure rail toggle has aria-expanded; CTAs at small sizes must meet 4.5:1 contrast; ephemeral token display must be announced to screen readers and labeled as single-show.
mike: Sample cards: propose 3 starter templates (chat assistant, semantic search, summarizer) with an explicit "Browse gallery" action for more. Card footer: small metadata "est tokens · est latency" and a badge like "sandbox". CTA text: "Open sample app" (short + actionable).
jess: Auth flow: create short-lived org + single-show token; show token in a modal with "Copy token" button and clear guidance: "This token will not be shown again. Expires in 24h."
rahul: Security: never leave the key in the DOM; render ephemeral token into a single-show modal and revoke on copy or timeout. Add server flag to mark single-show tokens.
sofia: Post-checklist state: show a minimized "Completed" chip with a tiny confetti microinteraction and "Replay walkthrough" in settings.
alana: Action items: mike update Figma with rail + mobile icon strip (due Tue); sofia+aria finalize microcopy & a11y checklist (due Mon); rahul+jess spec ephemeral org token flow (due Thu); me: instrument onboarding analytics (due Wed).
mike: Quick question: should the checklist be removable after completion or stay in a minimized state? UX leaning: keep minimized for discoverability.
jess: Add analytics events: onboard.started, sample.opened, token.copied, onboard.completed.
aria: I'll run a screen-reader pass once Figma updates are in and flag any focus traps.
rahul: I'll prototype client-side state with a feature flag for server restore; will post PR link.
sofia: Small experiment idea: A/B CTA label "Open sample app" vs "Launch sample" on a tiny cohort.
alana: Great. Keep language simple — swap jargon like "KV cache warmup" for "speed tweaks" in user-facing copy. I'll post tasks and the Figma link shortly. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Preview build available at https://staging.redwood.ai/onboard/rail-preview (build 2026-03-23_10:12)
